program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (first-row (let loop
                                  ((r 0))
                                  (if (or
                                        (>= r hh)
                                        (for/or ((c (range 0 ww))) (!= (at g r c) 0)))
                                      r
                                      (loop (+ r 1)))))
                  (last-row (let loop
                                 ((r (- hh 1)))
                                 (if (or
                                       (< r 0)
                                       (for/or ((c (range 0 ww))) (!= (at g r c) 0)))
                                     r
                                     (loop (- r 1)))))
                  (period (+ 1 (- last-row first-row))))
             (build-grid hh
                         ww
                         (r c)
                         (at g
                             (+ first-row
                                (remainder (+ (remainder (- r first-row) period) period)
                                           period))
                             c))))))
